sections.overview:
The Peacock whitepaper provides comprehensive technical and economic documentation for Peacock, a fan-driven deflationary BEP-20 token deployed on Binance Smart Chain. It outlines the token's core architecture, including a 10% burn mechanism per transaction, 50% initial supply burn, and 42% liquidity lock on PancakeSwap to prevent whale manipulation. The document covers blockchain infrastructure fundamentals, tokenomics structure with 420 quintillion total supply, and community protection mechanisms like the Dip Damage Protection Wallet designed to safeguard against price manipulation. The whitepaper explicitly positions Peacock as experimental entertainment rather than investment, detailed for developers, community members, and users evaluating the token's decentralized finance mechanics on BSC.
Review tokenomics structure for deflationary meme token projects on BSC
Understand community-driven token protection and governance mechanisms
Evaluate Binance Smart Chain BEP-20 token architecture and supply burn strategies
Research decentralized finance liquidity mechanisms and whale prevention tactics
